fields.description: The specific Agent Procedure version this run executes.
fields.label: Procedure

fields.description: Denormalized from procedure.procedure_id for grouping/reporting across versions of the same logical procedure.
fields.label: Procedure ID
Status
fields.options:
Queued
Running
Paused
Completed
Failed
Cancelled

fields.description: Telemetry linkage (I5): Agent Run -> Agent Procedure Run -> many Agent Tool Call.
fields.label: Agent Run

fields.description: fingerprint of procedure at the moment this run started. Execution and resume always read pinned_definition_json below, never procedure's current version (I6, GT-01) -- procedure may move on to a newer version while this run is still in flight.
fields.label: Pinned Fingerprint

fields.description: Exact copy of procedure.definition_json captured at run creation. The runtime executes this copy, never a re-fetch of Agent Procedure.
fields.label: Pinned Definition JSON

fields.description: Per-node state, one row per graph node visited. A frontier, not a single cursor (GT-02) -- see Agent Procedure Step.
fields.label: Steps

fields.description: List of node_ids that reached Completed. Denormalized read-convenience over steps (GOAL.md 2.4); T-32 reads this.
fields.label: Completed Steps

fields.description: node_id of the step that failed and stopped the run, if any.
fields.label: Failed Step

fields.description: Writes that succeeded and cannot be rolled back -- T-32 fallback protocol must never retry these.
fields.label: Committed Writes

fields.description: Writes that were planned/attempted but whose outcome is unconfirmed.
fields.label: Pending Writes

fields.description: Node outputs produced so far, keyed by node_id -- lets a resumed/fallback run reuse prior work instead of recomputing (subject to I7 budget rules).
fields.label: Intermediate Outputs

fields.description: Structured failure detail: {node_id, type, message, ...}. Not a raw traceback string -- see GOAL.md section 2.4.
fields.label: Error

fields.description: Actions T-32's fallback protocol may safely take given committed_writes/pending_writes (e.g. retry, skip, escalate to agentic execution per I9).
fields.label: Safe Recovery Actions
